description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeViewModel class, which manages the state and actions for the home screen of an Android app, including fetching installed apps and toggling app hide/lock states.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel for managing the home screen, handling app list retrieval and toggle actions for hiding and locking apps.

methods.name: toggleHidden
methods.description: Asynchronously toggles the hidden state of an app given its package name.

methods.name: toggleLocked
methods.description: Asynchronously toggles the locked state of an app given its package name.
